summary: Patria Investments filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing board changes: Mr. Glen George Wigney resigned from the Board and Ms. Ana Cristina Russo was appointed interim Board member, both effective September 3, 2026. Russo previously served as Patria's CFO from October 2022 to April 2026, making this a board-level rather than executive-officer shift. No compensation, share, stake, price, premium, advisor, or transaction terms were disclosed. The filing is a foreign-private-issuer notice under Rule 13a-16, functionally equivalent to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure. What to watch: whether the 'interim' designation precedes a permanent board seat and any further governance or succession changes.
